Gulshan Kumar & T-Series presents Bhushan Kumar's "Dil Lauta Do " official music video. This new romantic song is sung by Jubin Nautiyal & Payal Dev, music by Payal Dev, lyrics are written by Kunaal Vermaa. The song video features Sunny Kaushal & Saiyami Kher . The video is directed by Navjit Buttar. Enjoy & stay connected for more musical updates. Hit 'LIKE' if you this song.
Get ready for an emotional roller-coaster ride that will make you fall in love and feel the pain it brings.
